question: If sin(x - y) = 1/2 and cos(x + y) = 1/2, then what is the value of sin x cos x + 2sin²x + cos³x sec x ?
solution:
**Given:**

sin(x - y) = 1/2

cos(x + y) = 1/2

**Calculation:**

sin(x - y) = 1/2

⇒ sin(x - y) = sin 30° 

⇒ x - y = 30° ...............(i)

cos(x + y) = 1/2

⇒ cos(x + y) = cos 60° 

⇒ x + y = 60° .................(ii)

Add equation (i) and (ii), we get

⇒ 2x = 90°

⇒ x = 45° 

sin x cos x + 2sin2x + cos3x sec x

⇒ sin x cos x + 2sin2x + cos²x

Put the value of x in above equation

⇒ sin 45° × cos 45° + 2sin² 45° + cos² 45°

⇒ 1/√2 × 1/√2 + 2(1/√2)² + (1/√2)²

⇒ 1/2 + 1 + 1/2

⇒ 2

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
